items.title: Clem Raymond Interview, 1958-08-25
items.q: Well, I can recall a saxophone player. And he's dead. His name was Bynum.

ctx.x: Called Dink's Place. And musicians, what do you call it? Musicians Club or something. I don't remember. Who else was in the band?
Well, I can recall a saxophone player. And he's dead. His name was Bynum. That's all I can remember. The trumpet player. He was a fucker.
